inceleme_notu:
1.68 OZELLIK KALDIRAN bir surumdur. YENI izin, YENI veri toplama, YENI satin alma YOKTUR.
Aksine: mikrofon izni TAMAMEN KALDIRILDI (sesli iletisim cikti) ve konum izni metinleri kulup/sesli konvoy gerekcelerinden arindirildi.

KALDIRILANLAR: sesli sohbet / bas-konus telsiz / interkom · yazili sohbet · kulupler · liderlik tablosu · rozetler · yil ozeti · guvenli surus bildirimi · rota paylasimi (gonderme ve gelen kutusu) · nabiz paylasimi anahtari · Ultra abonelik katmani.

KALANLAR: rota kaydi · otonom video uretimi (artik herkeste 3B) · gunluk ozet · arkadas ekleme (yalniz ikili surus videosu icin) · tek Premium abonelik.

Mevcut Ultra aboneler MAGDUR OLMAZ: abonelikleri Premium olarak calismaya devam eder. Ultra ve Sokak urunleri App Store Connect'te satistan kaldirildi.

NOT: bu surumde bir profil hatasi da giderildi — kullanici adi ve profil fotografi bazi durumlarda gorunmuyordu.
asc_inceleme_notu_en:
Move Log turns recorded GPS rides (motorcycle, bicycle, walking, running) into cinematic satellite route videos.

WHAT CHANGED IN 1.68
This release REMOVES features. There are no new permissions, no new data collection and no new purchases. On the contrary, the microphone permission was removed entirely (all voice communication is gone) and the location permission strings no longer mention clubs or voice convoy announcements.

REMOVED: voice chat / push-to-talk radio / intercom, text chat, clubs, leaderboard, badges, year-in-review, ride-safety notification, route sharing (both sending and the inbox), the heart-rate sharing toggle, and the Ultra subscription tier.

KEPT: ride recording, autonomous video generation (now 3D for everyone), daily summary, adding friends (only to pair up for a two-rider video) and a single Premium subscription.

Existing Ultra subscribers are not harmed: their subscription keeps working as Premium. The Ultra and Street products have been removed from sale in App Store Connect.
This build also fixes a profile bug where the username and profile photo could fail to load.

HOW TO TEST
Sign in with Google or Apple, open Routes, pick any ride and tap 'Video olustur' (Create video). Premium is required for cloud video; the review account already has it. The bottom bar has four tabs: Routes, My Videos, Summary, Profile.
